name: io.github.spoc-app/mcp-bridge
description: MCP bridge that connects Claude Desktop, Cursor, Zed and other stdio MCP clients to the SPOC caret-handle identity, communications, and witnessed-action platform at spoc.com.
title: SPOC

environmentVariables.name: SPOC_BEARER
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token from https://spoc.com/settings/api-keys. Omit for anonymous access; required for tools that need a principal (e.g. spoc.harness.issue).

environmentVariables.name: SPOC_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: HTTP JSON-RPC endpoint. Defaults to https://spoc.com/mcp/rpc.

environmentVariables.name: SPOC_EVENTS_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: SSE endpoint for server-initiated notifications. Defaults to https://spoc.com/mcp/events.

environmentVariables.name: SPOC_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: HTTP request timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000.

environmentVariables.name: SPOC_DISABLE_SSE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to skip the SSE event stream (notifications become unavailable).

environmentVariables.name: SPOC_DEBUG
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to log debug output to stderr.
